description: This file defines a collection of simple-methods in OFBiz's MiniLang, primarily related to setup and configuration tasks such as creating organizations, customers, product stores, categories, and other entities. It contains various procedures for entity creation, validation, and service calls to set up the application environment.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Creates a new organization, including party, role, address, contact numbers, email, and associated accounting periods, and initializes related setup.

methods.name: setupDefaultGeneralLedger
methods.description: Sets up default general ledger accounts and preferences for a new organization, including GL journal creation and importing chart of accounts.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a customer user within the system, setting necessary roles and related user data.

methods.name: createFacilityAndContactMech
methods.description: Creates a facility entity with associated contact mechanisms, including address and contact numbers, and assigns purposes like shipping and shipping origin.

methods.name: createProductStoreWithDefaultSetting
methods.description: Creates a new product store with default settings, import related data such as shipping and product data, and sets pricing policies.

methods.name: createProdCatalogAndProductStoreCatalog
methods.description: Creates a product catalog and links it to a product store catalog.

methods.name: createProductCategoryAndAddToProdCatalog
methods.description: Creates primary, promotion, and promotional categories, adds categories to a catalog, and creates category rollups.

methods.name: createUpdateProductInCategory
methods.description: Creates or updates a product within a category, including features, pricing, and categorization.

methods.name: createDefaultWebSite
methods.description: Creates a default website entity with a fixed webSiteId of 'WebStore'.
